argv:
set -euo pipefail
fixed_root="/vaso/build/torchvision-cu129"
if [ "$(cat "$fixed_root/owner" 2>/dev/null)" != "{work}" ]; then
  echo "fixed torch build root $fixed_root is owned by another action" >&2
  exit 2
fi
set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; rm -rf "{work}/wheelhouse"; mkdir -p "{work}/wheelhouse"; python3 -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-index --no-cache-dir -w "{work}/wheelhouse" "/vaso/build/torchvision-cu129/src"; set -- "{work}/wheelhouse"/torchvision-*.whl; if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -f "$1" ]; then echo 'expected exactly one wheel matching torchvision-*.whl' >&2; exit 2; fi

set -euo pipefail
fixed_root="/vaso/build/torchvision-cu129"
rm -rf "$fixed_root"
mkdir -p "$fixed_root/src"
printf "%s\n" "{work}" > "$fixed_root/owner"
cp -a "{src}/." "$fixed_root/src/"
env_file="$1"
shift
root="$PWD"
abs_prefix() ( case "$1" in /*) printf "%s\n" "$1" ;; *) printf "%s/%s\n" "$root" "$1" ;; esac )
torch="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
python="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
python_venv="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_pip="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_setuptools="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_wheel="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_numpy="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_pillow="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_filelock="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
cuda="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
ninja="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
libjpeg_turbo="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
libpng="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
zlib_ng="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
compiler_prefix_map_flags=""
cuda_prefix_map_flags=""
for logical_map_root in $torch $python $python_venv $py_pip $py_setuptools $py_wheel $py_numpy $py_pillow $py_filelock $cuda $ninja $libjpeg_turbo $libpng $zlib_ng; do
  resolved_map_root="$(readlink -f "$logical_map_root" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$logical_map_root")"
  for map_root in "$logical_map_root" "$resolved_map_root"; do
    compiler_prefix_map_flags="$compiler_prefix_map_flags -ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
    cuda_prefix_map_flags="$cuda_prefix_map_flags -Xcompiler=-ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
  done
done
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$env_file")" "{work}/home" "{work}/pip-cache"
cat > "$env_file" <<EOF
set -euo pipefail
export BUILD_VERSION=0.29.0
export PYTORCH_VERSION=2.14.0
export FORCE_CUDA=1
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=10.0
export TORCHVISION_USE_PNG=1
export TORCHVISION_USE_JPEG=1
export TORCHVISION_USE_WEBP=0
export TORCHVISION_USE_NVJPEG=1
export PYTHONHOME=
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
export PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
export PIP_NO_INDEX=1
export PIP_NO_INPUT=1
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CUDAFLAGS="$CUDAFLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export NVCC_FLAGS="$NVCC_FLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export CMAKE_C_COMPILER="$CC"
export CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$CXX"
export CUDA_HOME="$cuda"
export CUDA_PATH="$cuda"
export PYTHONPATH="$torch/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_pip/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_setuptools/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_wheel/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_numpy/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_pillow/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_filelock/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$python_venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
export PATH="$python_venv/bin:$python/bin:$py_pip/bin:$py_wheel/bin:$ninja/bin:$cuda/bin:$libpng/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$torch/lib:$torch/lib/python3.13/site-packages/torch/lib:$cuda/lib64:$cuda/lib:$libjpeg_turbo/lib:$libjpeg_turbo/lib64:$libpng/lib:$libpng/lib64:$zlib_ng/lib:$zlib_ng/lib64"
export LIBRARY_PATH="$cuda/lib64:$cuda/lib:$libjpeg_turbo/lib:$libjpeg_turbo/lib64:$libpng/lib:$libpng/lib64:$zlib_ng/lib:$zlib_ng/lib64"
export TORCHVISION_INCLUDE="$libjpeg_turbo/include:$libpng/include:$zlib_ng/include"
export TORCHVISION_LIBRARY="$libjpeg_turbo/lib:$libjpeg_turbo/lib64:$libpng/lib:$libpng/lib64:$zlib_ng/lib:$zlib_ng/lib64"
export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$torch:$python:$cuda:$ninja:$libjpeg_turbo:$libpng:$zlib_ng"
export MAX_JOBS={jobs}
export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL={jobs}
export MAX_CONCURRENCY={jobs}
export HOME="{work}/home"
export PIP_CACHE_DIR="{work}/pip-cache"
EOF
